title: Ember Pattern (blinking)
rules_text: Ember Pattern with one Beat added: Embermaw steps out of the fire and back in beside the guardian.

instant_beats.title: Ember Step
instant_beats.rules_text: Embermaw goes out like a flame and relights within reach of the guardian. There is no distance to keep.

instant_beats.title: Stoke the Forge
instant_beats.rules_text: Embermaw banks its own fire. Every Heat it carries makes every blow land harder, and it never cools on its own. While Embermaw is at maximum Heat at the end of a Round, Escalation rises by 1.

instant_beats.title: Ember Scar
instant_beats.rules_text: The ground under the last pattern stays Scorched.

incoming_beats.title: Within Reach
incoming_beats.rules_text: If no hero stands adjacent to Embermaw at the end of this Round, Escalation rises by 1.
